ValidationRule.description: for community user cannot change opportunity , school ,campus,program,major once saved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:User.ContactId)), OR(PRIORVALUE(Opportunity__c) <> Opportunity__c, PRIORVALUE( School__c ) <> School__c , PRIORVALUE( Campus__c ) <> Campus__c , PRIORVALUE( Program__c ) <> Program__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change Opportunity , School , Program and Campus.
